SPACE EXPO · ABOUT & CREDITS

Project Overview

SPACE EXPO is an advanced interactive solar system and spaceflight simulator developed to deliver authentic orbital mechanics, interplanetary transit trajectory planning, and high-fidelity spacecraft simulation in an accessible web experience.

Simulator Capabilities

  • Keplerian Solar System: 28+ celestial bodies modeled with real NASA orbital parameters, inclinations, eccentricities, and axial tilts.
  • Dual Speed-Control System: Fully independent controls for global planetary time progression (with reverse playback and custom multipliers) and player spacecraft velocity.
  • Space Shuttle Orbiter Simulation: Exterior orbiter with thermal protection tiles, realistic RCS/OMS thrusters, and interactive 360° glass cockpit flight deck.
  • Interplanetary Mission Planner: Hohmann transfer calculations, delta-v budgets, flight durations, and solar radiation hazard modeling.
  • Scale Tour: Seamless cosmic zoom from Earth across astronomical units to our local stellar neighborhood and the Milky Way.

Technologies Used

JavaScript (ES6+), Three.js (WebGL 3D Rendering), GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), HTML5 Canvas, Web Audio API, and CSS3 Hardware-Accelerated Transforms.

Project Branding & Legal Notice

SPACE EXPO is an independent educational simulation project. NASA, Space Shuttle, and Solar System Scope textures and data are referenced under public domain and CC BY 4.0 licenses. SPACE EXPO is not a registered trademark and makes no claim of governmental or commercial certification.
